semantic_controls: EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement and instrumentation overhead is separated from server/client elapsed time
actual rows and actual time are interpreted per loop; parent inclusive timing is not summed naively
buffer hit does not mean zero physical I/O because PostgreSQL shared buffers and OS page cache are distinct layers
PostgreSQL prepared plans are described as custom-versus-generic selection, not SQL Server-style first-value plan freezing
parameterization remains mandatory for injection prevention even when plan specialization is needed
the tuning project requires multiset and schema parity, not only equal row counts
an 8 KiB page is the normal build default, not a universal database page size
pg_buffercache observations are snapshots and can be concurrently inconsistent
buffer hit ratio is not promoted to a universal top-level performance metric without workload and I/O context
monotonic inserts concentrate activity on the rightmost B-tree path but are not assumed slower than random inserts without measurement
B-tree height is measured with PostgreSQL level conventions rather than inferred only from row count
index bloat, fragmentation and free space are kept distinct
coursera: not used; deferred to module construction by owner policy
